generations.name: Neue Klasse (NA5)
generations.notes: First iX3 sold in North America (the earlier G08 iX3 was never sold here). Gen6 eDrive, 800 V, cylindrical cells, 108.7 kWh net (Europe; US figure reported about 112 kWh), up to 400 kW DC for the 50 xDrive. Confidence: medium-high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BMW_iX3 ; https://www.bmwblog.com/2025/09/06/2027-bmw-ix3-rear-wheel-drive-confirmed/
